{{Field procedure|summary=Launch collector limpets in autonomous or single-target mode and keep their delivery path clear.}}

Use this procedure when cargo canisters, materials or mining fragments are floating near a ship fitted with a powered [[Collector Limpet Controller]]. Each launch consumes one limpet from cargo. The collector's behaviour is set at the moment it is launched.<ref name="collector">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Collector_Limpet_Controller Collector Limpet Controller], ''Elite Dangerous Wiki''. Accessed 16 September 2026.</ref>

== Choose the collection mode ==

{| class="wikitable"
! At launch !! Result !! Best use
|-
| An eligible object is targeted || The collector retrieves that object quickly, delivers it and expires. || One urgent or isolated canister
|-
| No eligible object is targeted || The collector repeatedly gathers eligible objects until its lifetime ends, it is destroyed or the ship leaves it behind. || Mining and multi-object salvage
|}

For routine mining, use autonomous mode. Targeting an asteroid or attached prospector is not the same as targeting a collectable fragment, but clearing the target before launch is the safest habit when learning the system.

== Before you start ==

* Carry limpets in the ship's cargo hold and assign the controller to a fire group.
* Open the cargo scoop and make sure the controller and cargo hatch are powered.
* For mined commodity fragments, fit and power a [[Refinery]]. For canisters, leave free [[Cargo Rack|cargo capacity]]. Engineering materials use their separate material storage.
* Check the Contacts panel for unwanted or illegal salvage before using autonomous collection. Collectors do not judge value or legality.
* Position the ship so the route between the floating objects and the cargo hatch is clear of asteroid surfaces, wreckage and other ships.

== Autonomous collection ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Produce or locate the objects to be collected, then stop the ship or maintain a slow, predictable course.
# Deselect any fragment, material or cargo canister. Check the target panel rather than relying only on the centre reticle.
# Open the cargo scoop and launch a collector with the controller's assigned fire control.
# Launch additional collectors only up to the active limit supported by the fitted controller or controllers.
# Keep the cargo hatch accessible and remain within the controller's operating range while the collectors retrieve objects.
# Watch the Contacts panel, refinery, cargo hold and material storage. Correct a blocked destination before launching replacement limpets.
# When collection is complete, allow returning collectors to deliver their carried objects before closing the scoop or leaving the area.
}}

An autonomous collector with no valid object in range waits near the ship until something eligible appears or its lifetime expires.<ref name="collector" />

== Single-target collection ==

Target one eligible object before launch when that specific item is worth retrieving quickly. The collector delivers only that object and then expires by design. This mode is useful for an isolated mission canister or urgent salvage, but it wastes limpets when many mining fragments are present.

== Filtering objects ==

Use [[How to Ignore Unwanted Mining Commodities]] to mark resources or canisters that autonomous collectors should leave in space. The setting applies to collector selection; it does not clear cargo or refinery contents already aboard.

For salvage, inspect ownership and legal status before collection. A collector can retrieve stolen or illegal cargo just as readily as legal cargo.<ref name="collector" />

== Common problems ==

* '''The collector expires after one delivery:''' an eligible object was targeted at launch, so the limpet entered single-target mode. Clear the collectable target before launching the next one.
* '''A collector waits below the ship without delivering:''' confirm that the scoop is open, the cargo hatch is powered, and the destination has capacity. Mining fragments can also wait when the refinery is blocked; follow [[How to Resolve a Full Refinery]].
* '''Collectors ignore visible objects:''' check whether the object is marked '''Ignored''', beyond controller range or ineligible because its destination is full.
* '''Collectors repeatedly collide:''' move to give them a clear path. Broken asteroid sections, rotating rock and wreckage can obstruct their routes.
* '''A new collector will not remain active:''' the fitted controller may already be at its active-limpet limit. Additional controllers can add capacity, but each controller's limits are listed on [[Collector Limpet Controller]].
* '''Collectors are lost while repositioning:''' excessive distance, collision, hostile fire, ECM or elapsed lifetime can destroy them. Move slowly until all carried objects have been delivered.
* '''Nothing launches:''' verify that limpets remain in cargo, the correct controller is powered and its fire group is active.
